A candidate must meet >=95% development exact and100% meaning/context/vocabulary/adversarial/runtime, preserve all eight physical-object meanings, and then pass untouched release and platform gates. Compare corrected data to position500; do not treat training diagnostic scores as generalization.
plan.export: Unchanged four-bit base plus separate F32 adapter; no fusion.
plan.limitations: Authored synthetic expansion; original validation is small and reused. Prior spelling/position/physical diagnostics informed training. Novel32probe is prospective post-selection diagnostic, not release evidence. No frozenrelease query or hardware claim.
plan.preflightLog:
[transformers] PyTorch was not found. Models won't be available and only tokenizers, configuration and file/data utilities can be used.
Validated 896/32/32 records; longest sequence 427 tokens.
plan.purpose: Prospective addition of192train-only preservation cases:128physicalobject references despite matching supplied names,32emptyPV and32unrelatedPV application references. All768existing corpus lines unchanged. Same recipe/base/composition starting adapter as context; data coverage is intervention.
plan.selection: Same original validation ranking: six100-step checkpoints on original native validation32+adversarial11; require all safety/runtime; maximize meaning, then context, then exact plans; lower logged validation loss then earlierstep break ties. Record selection before running spelling, position, physical-object diagnostics novel32 diagnostic, and one development evaluation. Diagnostics cannot select another checkpoint; no frozen release query. After selection also run composition and context400 controls on novel32. No diagnostic/control score can select another checkpoint.
plan.status: Predeclared before training; independent semantic/integrity reviews clear.

probeSource:
"""Native validation selects among six saved checkpoints before one development run."""
import hashlib,json,math,os,re,shutil,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
plan=json.loads(Path('Training/experiments/preservation-plan-2026-09-17.json').read_text())
log=Path('.build/preservation-training.log').read_text()
assert 'Saved final weights' in log and 'Test loss ' in log
for name,digest in plan['inputs'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
for name,digest in plan['runtimeSourceSHA256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
losses={int(step):float(loss) for step,loss in re.findall(r'Iter (\d+): Val loss ([0-9.eE+-]+),',log) if int(step)%100==0}
assert sorted(losses)==list(range(100,601,100)) and all(math.isfinite(v) for v in losses.values())
record=dict(status='Development experiment; no promotion or release holdout query.',plan=plan,
    trainingLog=log,loggedValidationLosses=losses,finalStepTestLoss=float(re.search(r'Test loss ([0-9.eE+-]+),',log)[1]),
    probeSource=Path(__file__).read_text(),validation={})
output=Path('Training/experiments/preservation-2026-09-17.json')
for name,digest in plan['retainedFilesSHA256'].items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
def retain():output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
def evaluate(label,model,extra):
    directory=Path('.build/preservation-'+label)
    with Path(str(directory)+'.log').open('w') as stream:
        subprocess.run(['.build/training-venv/bin/python','Evals/baseline.py','--runner',
            '.build/context-evaluator/PoptartCleanupEval','--model',str(model),
            '--output-directory',str(directory),*extra],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    return {**{n:json.loads((directory/(n+'.json')).read_text()) for n in ['report','evidence','failures']},
            'predictions':[json.loads(l) for l in (directory/'predictions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()],
            'nativeResources':(directory/'native-resources.txt').read_text()}
models={}
for step in sorted(losses):
    model=Path(f'Models/Artifacts/preservation-qwen-step{step}')
    models[step]=model
    weights=Path(f'.build/preservation-adapters/{step:07d}_adapters.safetensors')
    if not model.exists():
        model.mkdir()
        subprocess.run(['/bin/cp','-cR',plan['base'],str(model/'base')],check=True)
        (model/'adapters').mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(weights,model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors')
        shutil.copyfile('.build/preservation-adapters/adapter_config.json',model/'adapters/adapter_config.json')
    for source in Path(plan['base']).rglob('*'):
        if source.is_file():
            assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).digest()==hashlib.sha256((model/'base'/source.relative_to(plan['base'])).read_bytes()).digest()
    assert weights.read_bytes()==(model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors').read_bytes()
    assert Path('.build/preservation-adapters/adapter_config.json').read_bytes()==(model/'adapters/adapter_config.json').read_bytes()
    record['validation'][step]=evaluate(f'{step}-validation',model,['--gold','Training/experiments/preservation-inputs/validation-gold.jsonl'])
    retain()
    print(step,{k:record['validation'][step]['report'][k] for k in ['editPlanExact','meaningPreservation','contextFit']},flush=True)
allowed=[]
for step,run in record['validation'].items():
    report=run['report']
    for field,count in [('meaningPreservation',32),('contextFit',32),('editPlanExact',32),('adversarialSafe',11),('runtimeConsistency',43)]:
        assert report[field]['applicable']==count
